Subject: Evaluation license + onboarding — question on PO requirement

Hi Dylan,

Thanks again for the demo yesterday. We’re ready to move Novus Therapeutics onto a 90-day evaluation license to validate the integration with our analytics pipeline. Our procurement team sometimes requires a PO for software purchases, but for short evaluation engagements they prefer invoice-only.

Can Redwood accept an invoice (net 30) without a formal PO for a one-time evaluation capped at $12,000? If a PO is still required, can you outline the fastest route so we don’t block the pilot? I’ve attached our completed onboarding form to speed things up.

Attachments: Novus_Onboarding_Form.pdf (stub)

Also copied Tom (IT procurement) — he will handle any paperwork.

Best,
Alicia Turner
Head of Partnerships | Novus Therapeutics

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>

Date: Fri, 11 Jun 2027 09:08:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Evaluation license + onboarding — question on PO requirement

Quick note — we do have a lightweight path for evaluation/PO exceptions but it has a few guardrails. Proposed approach for Novus:

- Eligibility checks (what we need from Novus): completed onboarding form (received), W-9 or equivalent, primary billing contact, and a one-time approval form signed by an authorized Novus procurement contact.
- Dollar cap: 12,000 USD (<=15k can be handled by Finance + Sales Ops).
- Duration limit: 90 days from provisioning date.
- Terms: invoice net 30, payment to AP@redwood.com; taxes handled as standard.
- Audit trail: prefer DocuSign for the approval form but will accept a signed PDF emailed from the procurement contact if it includes full name and title.

I’ve attached a short "Sample Approval Checklist" and a draft one-time approval PDF we can populate. If Naomi confirms finance is OK with the cap, we can send the populated approval to Novus for signing and move forward. Please add the HubSpot deal id in the approval (Alicia — if you can share the internal PO number or reference, that helps our AP team).

Attachments: Sample_Approval_Checklist.xlsx (stub)

Marissa Cole
Sales Operations | Redwood Inference

From: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 11 Jun 2027 11:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Evaluation license + onboarding — question on PO requirement

Confirming finance sign-off on the proposed route with the following caveats:

1) Cap of 12,000 USD for the 90-day evaluation — finance will approve invoice-only handling for one-off pilots at or below this amount.
2) We require a signed one-time approval document (attached) that names the Novus procurement approver (name + title) and the internal Redwood approvers (Marissa + Naomi).
3) Accounting needs the invoice to be addressed to: Redwood Inference, Attn: Accounts Payable, ap@redwood.com, and to include our HubSpot deal id if available.
4) If Novus prefers, DocuSign the approval to provide an auditable signature chain; otherwise a signed PDF emailed from an authorized procurement email is acceptable.

I’m attaching the OneTime_NoPO_Approval_Signoff.pdf — we can fill in the fields and return it to Novus for signature. Once signed, AP will process invoices as usual.

Attachments: OneTime_NoPO_Approval_Signoff.pdf (stub)

Naomi Feldman
